title: Maze Runner
description: Tile the canvas with 6 by 6 Truchet tiles. Every tile holds two quarter circle arcs of radius 0.5 (in tile units), about opposite corners, drawn as dark ink (0.1, 0.12, 0.25) lines 0.16 wide on cream (0.96, 0.92, 0.82). The first bit of the PCG hash pcg(pcg(x) + y) of the tile id (x, y) decides whether the tile is mirrored left to right. PCG is: state = v * 747796405u + 2891336453u; word = ((state >> ((state >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ state) * 277803737u; return (word >> 22u) ^ word. The canvas runs from -1 to 1, so each tile is 1/3 wide.
